title: Not to be missed. Unique experience to do at least once
text: Take all the time to enjoy the walk. Do not miss the entrance time to Nasrid palaces

title: Interesting Alhambra at your leisure.
text: Very pleasant and quiet visit enjoying the Alhambra at your leisure. Highly recommended for people with difficulty keeping pace with a group.

title: Good tour
text: The experience was good. We had all the tickets included. Although the audio guides are not very informative. You'd improve the audio guides.
